description: This file defines the ScreenRecordService class responsible for screen recording functionality using ReplayKit and AVFoundation. It includes methods to configure, start, stop, and finalize screen recordings, handle sample buffers, and manage capture states. The class also defines related error handling and internal data structures.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: A final class providing screen recording capabilities, managing capture states, configuring recording options, and interacting with ReplayKit for capturing screen and audio.

classes.name: CaptureState
classes.description: A class that manages the current state of the recording capture, including writer and input references, locking for thread safety, and error tracking.

classes.name: UncheckedSendableBox
classes.description: A generic wrapper for passing values across thread boundaries without compiler warnings related to Sendable conformance.

classes.name: RecordConfig
classes.description: A struct encapsulating the configuration parameters for a recording session, including duration, fps, audio inclusion, and output URL.

classes.name: ScreenRecordError
classes.description: An enumeration handling possible errors during screen recording, providing localized descriptions.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Main method to perform screen recording asynchronously, returning the output file path upon completion.

methods.name: makeRecordConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a RecordConfig based on provided parameters, validating inputs and generating output URL.

methods.name: makeOutputURL
methods.description: Generates an output URL based on a custom path or creates a temporary file URL.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Initiates the screen capture process and sets up handling via ReplayKit.

methods.name: makeCaptureHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler closure to process sample buffers from ReplayKit, directing video and audio samples accordingly.

methods.name: handleVideoSample
methods.description: Handles incoming video sample buffers, managing timestamp checks, writer setup, and appending samples.

methods.name: prepareWriter
methods.description: Initializes AVAssetWriter and its inputs based on the sample buffer and configuration.

methods.name: handleAudioSample
methods.description: Processes and appends audio sample buffers if applicable and recording is active.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Finalizes the capture session, finishing writing and checking for errors.

methods.name: finishWriting
methods.description: Completes the writing process for the current recording session asynchronously.
